insights: 1. Kenkere House revenue is up 18.5% Jan–Sep 2026 vs 2025, carried by existing clients: check-ins +46%, fill rate 31% → 48%.
2. New-client revenue share fell from 34% to 20%; leads fell from ~356/month (H1-2026) to ~152/month (Q3-2026). Acquisition is the gap to close.
3. Hosted-class guests convert at 3%; paid first visits at 40%. The funnel should lead with paid, credit-back trials.
4. March dips every year (clients wait for April); April is the peak. A March pre-sale monetises the wait.
5. A clean 25% off 1-month unlimited sold 38 units in Feb-2026 — use it sparingly (Feb, April flash, Mother's Day).
6. Pop-up revenue nearly doubled in 12 months (₹1.10L → ₹1.96L/month) but 75% is single credits — packs are the lever.
